director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch jaisi number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Achha, Riya. Cricket pitch ko 0 se 1 tak ek seedhi line samjho.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi
0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Ab isi par ek sawaal.
hmm, achha
Theek hai, Riya. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

pata nahi kaise, bas laga
Marks mat gino, gaps gino. Line ke upar 3 marks se 4 barabar gaps bante hain. Ab is par ek chhota sawaal.
screen par dikhao na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?

director.text: 1 by 10

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
hmm, achha
Pehla kadam dekho. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
